study: One follow-up on previously unscored C flower-photo accounts after wide-teacher qualification on A/B. Freeze before C pixels are decoded or scored.
question: Does imitating the aligned mean of a frozen teacher on a photo and its horizontal mirror help a fixed small student beyond an ordinary teacher, a randomly oriented teacher, or more direct-supervision time?
mechanism: The two orientations have the same block-mean observation rule. Randomly selecting one aligned teacher prediction and using their mean have the same expected student gradient under squared loss. Averaging removes orientation-sampling variance. The fixed teacher's accuracy relative to native orientation, and transfer to this student, are empirical.
base: protocol.json; use the same photo split, sources, training seeds, initialization, crop sequence, Adam and same wide teacher checkpoints. The stage-3 development result determines which original non-teacher candidate is eligible for evaluation.
student_output: All students receive a single nearest-upsampled block-mean image and produce the same 3061-parameter U-Net prediction with exact differentiable mean correction. Direct-supervision and KD arms all train with the correction inside the loss.

arms.plain: Direct supervision with the original clean crop.
arms.augmented_plain: Direct supervision, mirror the crop and its input together with probability 1/2 per example.
arms.ordinary: Mix clean crop with the projected native orientation teacher at weight 1/2.
arms.random_orientation: Run both teacher views. Select one per crop with independent probability 1/2, preserving input orientation for the student, teacher weight and forward-pass count.
arms.mean_orientation: Run the same two teacher views. Flip mirrored outputs back and average the two before mixing with the clean crop.
arms.plain_marginal_time: Direct-supervision student run for the measured student training time of mean_orientation, including online teacher forward passes.
arms.plain_total_time: Same ordinary directly supervised trajectory, run until it has also used the measured original wide teacher's training time. This is a one-teacher/one-student cost allocation. Record both deadlines and realized durations.

order: In each seed, rotate the five fixed-update arms. Discard one warmup fit fragment for each arm and exclude initialization, checkpoint copying, warmup, IO and evaluation from timing. Always run the two wall-time controls after the candidate duration is known. Same single CPU thread. Record the actual time imbalance, including any final step overshoot.
heldout: Fit all seeds and arms, freeze local weights and hashes first. Check that C has no shared account slug, photo ID or identical standardized pixels with train, A or B. Evaluate the frozen collection together. Report all C results. Also report native and flip-mean teacher as privileged-compute reference estimates. If earlier detail training qualified, evaluate its two prespecified comparisons on C at the same time.
transfer: For each of plain, augmented_plain, ordinary, random_orientation, plain_marginal_time and plain_total_time require mean C PSNR gain >=0.10 dB, positive gain in each seed and <=1% relative degradation of edge MAE. Treat the time comparisons as valid only if within 2% of the two deadlines. Also require an identical student graph and median batch-one latency no more than 10% above plain in a warmed, interleaved same-device test. Report per-photo paired bootstrap intervals conditional on all trained seeds, plus per-seed gains.
latency: For each of six model pairs, interleave ordinary directly supervised and mean-orientation students on the same 32x32 LR training photo, alternating order. Time upsampling, one student forward, and mean correction. Exclude decode/read. Discard 10 warmup rounds, time 70 rounds for each. Pool the 420 samples per arm; report median and P95.
alternative: If direct detail training qualified on A/B, compare its recorded matched-update and equal-wall checkpoints with the original whole-image-trained small model with the same inference correction. Apply base quality criteria separately to both C comparisons. Also show elementary bicubic and the same corrected bicubic as sanity baselines.
scope: One new account holdout within TensorFlow Flowers, not a claim of performance on another image collection. Stop this teaching variant on any failed transfer criterion. An independently promising direct-training result remains a separate candidate.
